agent.name: Vocatrya
agent.inputPlaceholder: Ask anything, paste a job posting, or request a review...
agent.addJobIntro:
Happy to add it. Paste the job posting here and I'll pull the details out of it.

If you don't have the posting text, tell me:
- **Company** — who is hiring
- **Job title** — the role they are hiring for
- **What the role involves** — one sentence is enough

You will see everything I extracted on a confirmation card before anything is saved.
agent.addCanonicalJobIntro: I can add this job. Tell me the company and the job title. Location, source, URL, and a description are optional — leave out anything you do not have, and I will not invent it. You will see what will be saved on a confirmation card before anything is written. Adding a job does not submit an application.
agent.emptyGreeting: I can add a job to your tracker — paste a posting or type the details, and I'll show you what I extracted before anything is saved. I can also read and review your resumes, and while you're looking at a job I can score how well one of them matches it or write you a cover letter. I can't search your existing jobs or read your tasks yet.

autoApply.name: Auto apply
autoApply.description: Use your career profile to fill application forms on job sites quickly.

detail.title: Auto-apply
detail.subtitle: Export selected non-sensitive career profile data as JSON for the companion browser extension, which fills job application forms.
usageSteps: Open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions) in Chrome/Edge and enable Developer mode.
Choose “Load unpacked” and select the extensions/auto-apply directory in this repository (where manifest.json lives).
Tick the sections to export on this page and click “Export JSON”.
Open the extension options page, click “Import profile backup”, pick the exported JSON, review it and save.
On a job site page, trigger the extension to fill the form. After profile changes, export and import again — importing replaces the whole copy.
detail.pluginInfo: Companion extension: OpenJobAutofill v{version} (upstream baseline v{upstreamVersion} @ {commit}, MIT)
detail.selectHint: Only checked sections are exported; sensitive data is never offered or read.
detail.exportDone: Exported {filename}. Import it via “Import profile backup” in the extension options.
boundaryNotes: The extension never clicks submit — you always submit the form yourself.
Fill activity does not create an “applied” fact in Vocatrya.
Upstream AI field matching is optional; Vocatrya neither wires in nor stores any AI credentials for the extension.
Connected sync needs Vocatrya running with a valid grant; manual export/import remains the fallback.

connect.subtitle: Once paired, the extension pulls the sections you granted on demand while Vocatrya runs. Revoked or expired connections cannot read data again; the extension marks stale copies clearly.
